rowRules: Exactly one of Debit and Credit must contain a positive amount.
Transaction rows must be ordered by transaction date and time.
RunningBalance must be supplied on every row or blank on every row; mixed values are rejected.
Supplied RunningBalance must equal the previous balance plus the signed movement.
Blank RunningBalance requires explicit account permission and the same wallet's approved opening count for the selected date at upload.
Computed balances use the approved opening plus successive credits minus debits; they are not bank-reported balances.
